title: 💻 How Claude Code works in large codebases: Best practices and where to start | Claude by Anthropic
content:
Claude Code 技术干货

Initializing in subdirectories, not at the repo root. Claude works best when it's scoped to the part of the codebase that's actually relevant to the task. In monorepos, this can feel counterintuitive because tooling often assumes root access, but Claude automatically walks up the directory tree and loads every CLAUDE.md file it finds along the way, so root-level context is never lost. [...] Keeping CLAUDE.md files lean and layered. Claude loads them additively as it moves through the codebase: root file for the big picture, subdirectory files for local conventions. The root file should be pointers and critical gotchas only; everything else drifts into noise. [...] Bottoms-up adoption generates enthusiasm but can fragment without someone to centralize what works. You need to have an individual or a team assemble and evangelize the right Claude Code conventions (such as a standardized CLAUDE.md hierarchy or a curated set of skills and plugins). Without that work, knowledge will stay tribal and adoption will plateau.

content:

Batch operations in Claude Code apply one change, such as a library migration, a rename or an API version removal, across dozens or hundreds of files. The bundled `/batch` skill plans the change, splits it into 5 to 30 independent units and runs each unit in its own git worktree as a background agent that opens a pull request. Claude Code generates buffered writers that accumulate results in memory and flush to disk in configurable batch sizes, reducing file system operations by orders of magnitude. title: 💻 Claude Code /batch vs claude -p: Parallel Changes or CI Automation - SmartScope
content:
Claude Code 技术干货

Choose `/batch` when applying bulk changes across an entire project. Choose headless mode when embedding AI processing into existing CI/CD pipelines.

## /batch Command: Parallel Execution of Large-Scale Code Changes¶

### Basic Usage¶

`/batch` is a bundled skill invoked with slash-command syntax inside an interactive Claude Code session.1 It researches the repository, proposes 5–30 independent units, waits for plan approval, and then creates one worktree-isolated background agent per unit.2 [...] Repeated multi-turn calls retain more context than a tightly scoped one-shot task. For independent file checks, short `claude -p` calls are easier to budget. For architecture review, preserving context can still be worth the additional usage.

Choosing the right approach for each use case is the key to balancing quality and cost.

## Summary¶

Claude Code's batch processing is built on two pillars: `/batch` and headless mode (`claude -p`). [...] Claude Code has two different ways to run work at scale. Use `/batch` to split one repository-wide change across independent worktrees and pull requests. Use `claude -p` when a script or CI job needs one non-interactive result.
